reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a OneCoin network with claims that participants will all win, rapidly multiply their investments, and achieve financial freedom. The speaker describes building teams and earning through network commissions, presents OneCoin as a secure income-generating currency, and directs viewers to join the network through the supplied signup and contact information.

the tens of members of my network who have doubled or even tripled their investments thanks to the marketing of OneCoin network
we would like to create their team of 4, de 3 as well as 5 people
do not hesitate to join our oneCoin network and enjoy its advantages and our support by sending me an email to the address that is displayed here below the screen
your personal and financial investment

opening.argument: The presentation includes its own acknowledgment that OneCoin has attracted negative coverage and accusations, rather than presenting a completely one-sided absence of criticism. It expressly notes that there are “many articles negative about OneCoin” and videos accusing it of being a scam, while leaving the viewer to assess the competing explanation for those criticisms. Its financial language also includes uncertainty around future value, using “could be” rather than presenting every projection as a settled fact. On this record, the video can be read as advocacy accompanied by discussion of controversy and uncertainty, not as a formal guarantee or verified financial certification.

citations.quote: Yet when we look through the net, we find many articles negative about OneCoin.
those videos shot by unknown people who accuse the WampCoin of being a scam
It could be 5,025euros when i get my start

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats promotional language as proof of deception, but “we will all win” is an aspirational statement, while reported earnings are attributed to members of the speaker’s network. The cited team language shows an organizational model, not by itself an unlawful or deceptive mechanism. The opening also omits that the speaker openly discusses negative articles and opposing accusations, which is inconsistent with presenting the subject as beyond criticism.

citations.quote: Because there is one thing that is certain with ONECIN is that we will all, all win!
the tens of members of my network who have doubled or even tripled their investments thanks to the marketing of OneCoin network
Yet when we look through the net, we find many articles negative about OneCoin.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Acknowledging criticism does not amount to a meaningful risk warning when the speaker immediately dismisses critics and continues urging enrollment. The presentation also goes beyond uncertainty: it says everyone will win, describes doubled or tripled investments, and calls the opportunity secure. A disclaimer cannot be inferred merely from mentioning hostile articles or using one conditional phrase about value.

Because there is one thing that is certain with ONECIN is that we will all, all win!
Today, ONECIN is the product that generates the most easily and with very great security money!

opening.argument: The video can reasonably be understood as commentary and practical discussion about network marketing, coaching, and an associated social project, rather than as a transaction-focused solicitation. The speaker explains that participants receive coaching, teamwork, information, and individual support, including help developing their own networks. It also presents a permaculture education project and explains its stated goals in agriculture, food, medical services, energy, technology, and economics. Those are educational and operational themes, while the speaker’s financial statements are presented as personal and community experience rather than independently verified market reporting.

citations.quote: through coaching, through teamwork, through individual work to which we will bring information and training
this system of individual and group coaching allows us to make the person understand
Our goal is to offer education in the new alternatives from agriculture, food, medical services, energy, technology and economics
In 2 months I can count now the tens of members of my network

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the content educational does not erase its subject matter. The cited coaching is specifically intended to help people create teams, and the speaker connects that structure to financial results. The invitation to join and the emphasis on earning are not incidental classroom examples; they are the practical outcome the audience is encouraged to pursue. The permaculture segment likewise does not change the central promotional context.

citations.quote: we would like to create their team of 4, de 3 as well as 5 people
Everyone is able to do it
do not hesitate to join our oneCoin network and enjoy its advantages and our support

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The training is not neutral skills education: it is described as coaching people to build teams within the network, with the stated objective of producing financial winners. The speaker says everyone can do it and urges viewers to join, so the instructional framing functions as recruitment. The unrelated project description cannot negate the repeated income and enrollment message.

citations.quote: we would like to create their team of 4, de 3 as well as 5 people
The result is wonderful the person's freedom for the financial aspect of both will win with this project
Everyone is able to do it

opening.argument: The supplied material does not show the concrete mechanics that would distinguish ordinary referral or network-marketing promotion from a scam: there is no demonstrated deposit procedure, no displayed payment request, no credential collection, and no verified payout transaction. What is actually described is a network-marketing service involving coaching, teamwork, information, and support. The speaker also discusses a separate permaculture education project that the network allegedly helps fund. The existence of a referral structure and optimistic promotion does not, without the missing mechanics, establish that participation is deceptive or that money must come from an undisclosed source.

citations.quote: through coaching, through teamwork, through individual work to which we will bring information and training
we support from day 1 until the day that this person is able to attend the meeting on their own
To fund this project we did not step into a bank.
Sign up for free

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a filmed checkout screen does not neutralize the explicit financial solicitation. The opening itself identifies personal and financial investment, reported multiplication of investments, network teams, and a direct invitation to join. A sign-up link and coaching structure are enough to show an enrollment pathway; the video need not display every payment or credential step for its promotional mechanism to be apparent.

citations.quote: your personal and financial investment
the tens of members of my network who have doubled or even tripled their investments thanks to the marketing of OneCoin network
do not hesitate to join our oneCoin network and enjoy its advantages and our support

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-mechanism argument overlooks that the speaker explicitly links personal investment and income to network marketing, commissions, and team formation. “Sign up for free” does not establish that participation is costless once inside the system, and the absence of a visible checkout is not evidence that no payment or investment is required. The claims of doubled or tripled investments and universal success provide the persuasive inducement.
